Items are NOT in reception foreground.

sourceRecognition.comments: Source photo-lobby directly inspected: THE REV logo wall left, potted palm before white reception counter, bouquet above counter, wooden stool on customer side, exposed white beams and black track lighting above. A rack, plates and bench are visible only at rear training area beyond reception. No customer or staff in source. Inventory positions are observed from source, not inferred from the generation prompt.

observation.comments: Exactly one female customer in a plain white T-shirt and dark exercise pants stands neutrally in reception, one relaxed hand lightly over lower abdomen and lips gently parted, appearing to check breathing before exercise. No squat, loaded exertion or machine operation. Rear rack, plates and bench remain behind reception rather than moved into foreground. Logo wall, palm, counter, bouquet, stool and overhead beams remain spatially corresponding; wider generated camera/crop and softening are present, no exact pixel preservation claimed. Face/hair, hand/fingers, arm lengths and torso joints look plausible. Floor/feet are cropped, so sole contact cannot be directly inspected. No trainer, staff, second person, private booth or new equipment.

article_review.title: 筋トレの呼吸、いつ吐く？動きと息を合わせる基本
article_review.comments: 本文は筋トレ呼吸の初歩と練習方法、スクワットは説明例。写真は受付で呼吸を意識する準備の一場面であり、受付で筋トレさせる描写はない。手を軽く腹に置く仕草は呼吸の自己確認として読め、痛みや医療処置を示す装置・苦痛表情はない。腹圧を高める効果、研究の結果、腰痛予防、実際のスクワット中の呼気相を写真が証明するとは扱わない。

api_usage.scope: Independent reviewer executed no paid API. Scene author used Work built-in generation once; broad QC and observation were performed through Work.

comments: 女性顧客1名の軽い腹部への手添え・自然に開いた口・運動前の落ち着いた立位は、初歩の呼吸を意識する記事固有の準備行動として成立。受付でスクワットや負荷運動は行っていない。後方のラック／プレート／ベンチは本来のトレーニングエリア内に留まり、受付へ移設されていない。顔、手の指、肩・肘のつながり、衣服と照明に重大な不自然さは見えない。最終copyは現行production Bridgeが作成した「筋トレの呼吸、いつ吐く。」であり、未採用の初期診断コピーへ戻していない。原寸・全6プレビューに対して直接Visual評価した。
limitations: The still image can show breathing awareness but cannot measure airflow, respiratory phase, intra-abdominal pressure or the timing of loaded exercise.
Feet are outside the three-quarter crop; sole-floor contact is not directly visible. No visible floating, cutout edge or body-scale defect is observed in frame.
Exact source pixels are not preserved; source scene geometry and equipment zones are visually compared within permitted generated framing/softening.
Visual PASS is not public asset byte verification, operational READY or human Publish approval. Parent must complete canonical adoption with exact accepted bytes.
